goal: Allow users and external wallets to protect blocks from being pruned without turning off pruning entirely
Prevents failed rescans when an external wallet is unloaded while the node continues processing blocks
reviewability: Reviewing the code now is worthwhile
Nothing known would invalidate a review now
agreement: Substantive support with multiple approvals and no open objections (achow101, stickies-v, sedited)
Verified by testing an electrs indexer integration on a pruned signet node (optout21)
Approvals on multiple revisions after earlier concurrency and extensibility concerns were fixed (sedited)
Concept approval with minor suggestions on RPC help text and test helpers (andrewtoth)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fills a long-standing interface gap for external wallets and indexers on pruned nodes
Downstream applications can retain required blocks on disk without disabling pruning entirely
